title: Rest resolves class data from bundled pack instead of campaign binding
description: Aggregate review of run #625-#638 (main a23bf6d5): completeShortRest/completeLongRest call restoreSpellSlots without a RulesPackCharacterResolver (falls back to bundled), and rest.ts resolvePool hard-codes getBundledDnd5eCharacterResolver for Hit Dice. An add-on Wizard-5 level-4 slot spent via spend_spell_slot is deleted by short-rest reconciliation and re-inserted full later (recharge); Hit Die overrides are ignored. Sibling: spend_rest_hit_die tool never threads ctx.resolveRulesPack. Fix: memoize the campaign resolver once per rest op, resolve the strict campaign stack once, build one character resolver, pass it to Hit Dice + slot reconciliation and the memoized resolver to usage/item consumers. Evidence: add-on rest regression in rest/spellSlots tests (slot stays spent at add-on capacity across short rest; Hit Die override honored; resolver answer change mid-op does not split the stack).
notes: PR #639 https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/639 opened (head 4c523277). verify:worktree green. Stays in_progress until merge.
